hints.text: Four values is an even count, so no single value sits exactly in the middle.
The two middle values of $2, 4, 6, 8$ are $4$ and $6$. Find the number halfway between them: $(4 + 6) \div 2$.
$(4 + 6) \div 2 = 5$, so the median of the set is $5$.

explanation: The set $2, 4, 6, 8$ is in order and has an even number of values.
With an even count, the median is the average of the two middle values, which are $4$ and $6$.
$(4 + 6) \div 2 = 5$, so the median of the set is $5$.
